items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And Pauline put in the bed. And Bob says, man, Pauline, you got a hard ball.

ctx.x: I was playing the show cold taking. And that woman said, Who's the drummer in there? I said, me. Anything wrong? I was playing with Bob Doher, man. You said, Bob Doher, you met Bob? Mm-hmm. He was a fine piano player, Bob. Bob and I used to go out between the sets to go get a little snort, you know. There you go. Great show. I said, Bob, two weeks ago, went to his house, man. And Pauline put in the bed. And Bob says, man, Pauline, you got a hard ball. I said, bring the hard ball, Pauline. I said, more down,…
Another lawyer can of his wife, huh? Yes, Bob. Pauline.
